dedupe_keys.name: maed energy demand scenario model code

description: MAED is the Model for the Analysis of Energy Demand, developed by the International Atomic Energy Agency. This repository publishes code to project final and useful energy demand from socioeconomic, technology and demographic scenarios. Users define sectors, end uses, activity and efficiency assumptions for a national or sub-national system; outputs are medium- to long-term demand by end-use category and period. Geographic coverage belongs to the case inputs, not a built-in national dataset. BSD-3-Clause source is public, and the README links IAEA model documentation and case-study guidance. A limitation is that the code does not determine future economic or technology pathways; those assumptions and local calibration must be supplied. MAED can prepare electricity, gas and heating demand scenarios for infrastructure capacity planning. The related catalogue PyPSA model is an electricity-system optimiser, not an MAED demand forecast. No case workbook, data or package was downloaded.
